$metadata.name: C9D Consulting — The Dossier
$metadata.description: Design tokens for the C9D Consulting brand system. Dark mode default; light mode for print-only artifacts.
$metadata.owner: C9D Consulting · a practice of Brandon Wilburn

provenance.darkMode: Locked in §9 Visual Identity Doc source. All hex values, ratios, and contrast figures verified against c9d-visual-identity-doc.md.
provenance.lightMode: DERIVED, NOT FROM SOURCE. Specific light-mode hex values were not specified in locked source; the values below are reasonable derivations for review. Verify against c9d-design-system-vol-01.html before using in print deliverables.
provenance.spatial: Composition ratio (70/22/6/2) and the 8px grid base are locked. The 9-step --space-N scale with the specific px values below is a proposal, not from locked source.

compositionRatio.note: Composition ratio is load-bearing. Pages should sit at this ratio; drift to 15% signal reads as decoration.

bg-2.use: Card and panel backgrounds, elevated surfaces

paper.use: Reserved for stamps and signed-off artifact moments

rule.use: Standard hairlines between sections, cells, rows

rule-bright.use: Emphasized borders, active, hover, schematic lines

ink-bright.use: Headlines, key data, hero copy, important emphasis

ink-dim.use: Tertiary metadata, page numbers, faint annotations

stamp.use: Primary signal: case IDs, section markers, key emphasis, classification labels, wordmark

stamp-dim.use: Reserved/aged secondary signal: footer text, stamp interiors

classified.use: Refusal markers, declined-engagement signals, crit-vulnerability moments only

grid.note: All spacing values are multiples of 8 except for the tightest typographic adjustments (4px allowed for inline-mono-to-ink alignment).

measure.note: Body text never exceeds this measure at the prevailing body size.

italic-accent.use: Inline emphasis and pullquotes only, never body, never headlines, never more than 8 consecutive words

mono.use: Metadata, file IDs, classifications, section markers, page numbers, eyebrows. ~40% of visible type surface.

xs-mono.use: File IDs, page numbers, status indicators, classifications

none.use: Default for everything in the system

color: Surface ratios are non-negotiable. Cover the type — if the chromatic balance reads as document, pass. If poster, fail.
Signal indexes the proof. Sodium amber marks case IDs, section markers, measured metrics, framework names, wordmark. Nothing else.
Crit red is rare. Reserved for declared refusals and rare crisis moments. The two warm colors must not compete.
Ink hierarchy is enforced. Body is ink; ink-bright is reserved for things the reader should remember. Roughly 15/65/15/5 distribution.
No additional colors without re-opening the system. No blue, green, purple. Charts use shades of existing palette.
typography: Default Inter / Roboto / Geist body without distinctive treatment is refused
Multiple display faces competing on one page is refused
Italicized blocks of body type is refused (italic reserved for inline emphasis)
Letterspacing as a primary device for display moments is refused
The stack 'Inter + JetBrains Mono with a quirky display' is refused — too default to remain distinctive
spatial: Cards lift off the ground (bg-2 cards on bg ground, separated by space-7 by default)
Hairlines do the work of whitespace
Asymmetric columns: two-column layouts use 5:7 ratio, not 1:1
Maximum measure: body never exceeds 65ch at body size
Eyebrow above title is mandatory (JetBrains Mono uppercase, ls 0.18em)
Mono metadata row at top of every major document or page

brand.forbidden: 'C9D' alone in body copy — conflicts with C9D Holdings namespace

numeronym.disclosure: Hybrid: discoverable but not promoted. Lives in about pages, spoken when asked, never volunteered in cold outreach.

founder.rule: Attribution mandatory on every major surface, default footer location

engagements.shortFormAllowed: After first full-form use within a single document

tagline.use: Locked closing line for manifesto-grade documents, footers, campaign signatures

pricing.publishedLanguage: from $X, fixed scope, fixed price. Quoted to the specific scope, complexity, and stakes of the work.
